scope: Shared replay runtime: Version/build metadata, localized replay naming, GameSlot disconnect state, reference counting, and socket reset

applied.name: GameSlot_IsDisconnected
applied.evidence: Returns isHuman() && m_disconnected, with the disconnected byte at offset 0x48.
applied.basis: exact-build assembly plus the SAGE1 inline GameSlot::disconnected implementation

applied.name: Version_CopyAssign
applied.evidence: Copies the four integer version components, seven owned AsciiString fields, and show-full-version byte of the 0x30-byte Version object.
applied.basis: all replay/GameSlot callers and the recovered Version layout

applied.name: Version_CommandLineSetShowFullVersion
applied.evidence: Parses a command-line boolean and stores it in TheVersion's show_full_version byte at offset 0x2C.
applied.basis: TheVersion data references, atoi call, and recovered field offset

applied.name: Version_GetBuildGuid
applied.evidence: Returns the embedded build GUID AsciiString at Version offset 0x1C.
applied.basis: recovered build-stamp field writes and WinMain title construction

applied.name: Replay_GetDefaultDisplayName
applied.evidence: Returns localized GUI:LastReplay through TheGameText, falling back to the wide string 00000000 when the text manager is unavailable.
applied.basis: exact-build string references and all four replay recording callers

applied.name: Version_FormatBuildIdentifier
applied.evidence: Formats the four Version integers as %d.%.2d.%d.%d.
applied.basis: exact-build format string, register arguments, and WinMain caller

applied.name: Version_GetAsciiVersion
applied.evidence: Formats the public release version as major.minor.
applied.basis: exact-build format string and network match-state caller

applied.name: Version_GetUnicodeVersion
applied.evidence: Formats the localized Unicode release version through Version:Format2.
applied.basis: exact-build string/xrefs and SAGE1 Version::getUnicodeVersion correspondence

applied.name: Version_GetAsciiBuildTime
applied.evidence: Formats build date and time as two space-separated AsciiString fields.
applied.basis: exact-build offsets/format and SAGE1 Version::getAsciiBuildTime correspondence

applied.name: Version_FormatDottedFourPart
applied.evidence: Formats all four Version integer components as %d.%d.%d.%d for replay metadata and network consumers.
applied.basis: assembly exposes all four arguments; five replay/network callers were reviewed

applied.name: Version_Ctor
applied.evidence: Zero-initializes the seven AsciiString handles and delegates to the embedded build-stamp loader.
applied.basis: 0x30-byte allocations/embeddings, field initialization, and SAGE1 Version constructor

applied.name: Version_LoadEmbeddedBuildStamp
applied.evidence: Parses VERSION, ID, USER, MACHINE, GUID, TIME, DATE, and CONFIG from the executable build-stamp string into the recovered Version fields.
applied.basis: exact string keys, default values, field writes, and sscanf arguments

applied.name: RefCountClass_Release_Ref
applied.evidence: Decrements NumRefs at offset 0x10 and invokes the virtual deleting path when it reaches zero.

applied.name: RefCountPtr_Release
applied.evidence: Tail-calls RefCountClass_Release_Ref on the pointer stored by a one-field reference wrapper.
applied.basis: seven replay ownership callers and exact release-helper tail call

applied.name: SocketTransport_CloseAndReset
applied.evidence: Closes the socket at offset 0x20, sets it to INVALID_SOCKET, and zeros six transport state fields from offsets 0x08 through 0x1C.
applied.basis: exact-build assembly and all three replay/network ownership callers

globals.name: TheVersion
globals.evidence: Global Version singleton; WinMain allocates a 0x30-byte Version here and the named TheVersionTypeHandler plus replay metadata consume it.

globals.name: TheGameText
globals.evidence: Global GameText manager singleton used through its fetch virtual method by replay naming and localized Version formatting.
